credits.title: Animali randagi
credits.overview: Drivers Luca and Toni are driving an ambulance to Serbia to repatriate Emir, a sick man searching for his past. Travelling with them is Maria, his daughter, who hasn’t seen him for years. The journey eastwards lays bare the secrets of four lives, propelling them towards a decisive turning point.

credits.title: My Killer Buddy
credits.overview: Denni is a 10-year-old boy with a mission: to save his mother from his father's violence. For this he devises a foolproof plan: he will have his father killed by a super-killer. Too bad the super-killer he comes across is Secco, who only looks like a criminal and, above all, desperately needs money.

credits.title: Corpo unico
credits.overview: In a dystopian present/future, women have become extinct. It is a world of male hunters, where even the memory of the femicide they committed is punished. The three male protagonists are locked up in a closed space because they are infected by the memory. It is poetic justice.

credits.title: Thank You Guys
credits.overview: An actor past his prime gives drama lessons to prisoners in an attempt to stage "Waiting for Godot."

credits.title: The Turning Point
credits.overview: A slacker who does his best to avoid confrontation strikes up an unlikely friendship with a dangerous thug who suddenly forces his way into his life.

credits.title: Bed Number 6
credits.overview: Doctor Bianca Valentino is hired to cover the night shift in the ward of a pediatric hospital. credits.title: Ordinary Justice
credits.overview: While a trial involving murder, manslaughter and armed robbery is being conducted inside the courtroom, the two daughters of the accused are sentenced to wait outside in the hallway.

credits.overview: The incredible true story behind the most controversial Italian court cases in recent years. Stefano Cucchi was arrested for a minor crime and mysteriously found dead during his detention. In one week's time, a family is changed forever.
